request.query: ring seminorm submultiplicative size polynomial remainder coefficient bound

items.name: RingSeminorm.mul_le'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] (self : RingSeminorm R) (x y : R),
  self.toFun (x * y) ≤ self.toFun x * self.toFun y

items.name: seminormFromBounded_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f →
    (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) →
      ∀ (x y : R), seminormFromBounded' f (x * y) ≤ seminormFromBounded' f x * seminormFromBounded' f y

items.name: seminormFromBounded
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {f : R → ℝ} →
      {c : ℝ} →
        f 0 = 0 →
          0 ≤ f →
            (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) →
              (∀ (a b : R), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) → (∀ (x : R), f (-x) = f x) → RingSeminorm R

items.name: seminormFromBounded_ge
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f → (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) → ∀ (x : R), f x ≤ f 1 * seminormFromBounded' f x

items.name: SeminormedRing.norm_mul_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_5} [self : SeminormedRing α] (a b : α), ‖a * b‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖b‖

items.name: MulRingSeminorm.map_mul'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : NonAssocRing R] (self : MulRingSeminorm R) (x y : R),
  self.toFun (x * y) = self.toFun x * self.toFun y

items.name: SeminormedRing.noConfusion
items.type:
{P : Sort u} →
  {α : Type u_5} →
    {t : SeminormedRing α} →
      {α' : Type u_5} → {t' : SeminormedRing α'} → α = α' → t ≍ t' → SeminormedRing.noConfusionType P t t'

items.name: seminormFromBounded_of_mul_is_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {f : R → ℝ} {c : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f →
    (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) →
      ∀ {x : R},
        (∀ (y : R), f (x * y) = f x * f y) →
          ∀ (y : R), seminormFromBounded' f (x * y) = seminormFromBounded' f x * seminormFromBounded' f y
